All 41 hash-bound fixture controls executed. The evidence-removal control reached: F — Live inventory evidence failed: ERROR: manifest validation_observation must be an object. The malformed-JSON control reached: F — Live inventory evidence failed: ERROR: invalid JSON in manifest.json: Expecting property name enclosed in double quotes at line 2 column 1. This A applies only to inventory provenance; fixture contents remain C.
requirements.next_step: Keep the inventory current. Real engine exports remain separate QCX/PTX/TFX requirements and require separately authorized slices.
